visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long brown hair stands against a plain white wall. Her hair is blowing vigorously towards the right, suggesting an off-screen fan. She wears a crisp white button-down shirt and delicate pearl drop earrings. Her facial expression is calm, looking directly into the camera lens with confidence. (2) The scene cuts to the woman smiling brightly as she places both her hands on her cheeks, cupping her face playfully. Her hair is now settled and still. The background remains white and well-lit with bright studio lighting. (3) She presents an open orange gift box titled 'Scalp Recovery'. Inside are two distinct product containers. She points her index finger at the box and then at a larger orange spray bottle. (4) Close-up on the woman's scalp as she parts her hair, which appears wet. She holds the orange 'Hair Tonic' bottle and demonstrates spraying it onto her scalp, followed by massaging the roots with her fingertips. (5) She holds a smaller orange glass bottle labeled 'Youth Serum' with a white dropper cap. She looks at the bottle and then at the camera, pointing at the product while maintaining a friendly smile. (6) Another scalp close-up shows her using the dropper to apply several drops of clear liquid to her hair part. Her fingers massage the area again. The lighting remains bright and even. (7) She holds both the spray tonic and the serum bottle together in front of her chest, showcasing them as a pair while looking into the camera. (8) She runs her hand through her long, silky brown hair, demonstrating the smooth and untangled texture. The hair has a healthy sheen under the studio lights. (9) She holds a thick lock of her hair between her fingers, pulling it down to show the texture and volume. She nods and smiles, expressing satisfaction with the results. (10) The scene changes to a modern indoor office space with large windows. She is dressed for going out, wearing a beige skirt and white top, carrying a bag. She turns, points one finger up with a wink and a smile, and begins to walk away.

It utilizes a fast-paced, high-energy editing style combined with upbeat EDM music to appeal to a modern audience. By showcasing the product's application and the resulting smooth, voluminous hair, it intends to build brand trust and encourage viewers to purchase the gift set for scalp health and hair beauty.
